 News › News News › SSC GD Constable PET/PST admit card 2026 released: Key Details for candidates SSC GD Constable PET/PST admit card 2026 released: Key Details for candidates
 Adhya Sarna Updated: Nov 13, 2026, 08:02 IST SSC GD Admit Card 2026 The Staff Selection Commission ( SSC ) has released the admit card for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) of the SSC GD Constable Examination 2026. The call letters were made available on 12 November 2026 on the official website, ssc.gov.in . Candidates who qualified in the written examination can now download their physical test admit cards online.
 Recruitment overview 
 The recruitment drive is aimed at filling 25,487 vacancies for the posts of Constable (General Duty) in the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) and the Secretariat Security Force (SSF), as well as Rifleman (General Duty) in Assam Rifles. The notification was issued on December 1, 2025, and the online application window remained open until December 31, 2025. The Computer Based Test (CBT) was conducted between April 27 and May 30, 2026, and the written examination result was declared on October 12, 2026.
 A total of 1,97,408 candidates have been shortlisted for the physical stage of the selection process.
 Schedule of the physical tests 
 The PET and PST are tentatively scheduled to be held from November 26 to December 11, 2026. The tests will be conducted under the authority of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) and the participating CAPFs. Candidates are advised to check their admit cards carefully for the exact date, time and venue assigned to them, as these details will vary across candidates.
 How to download the admit card 
 Candidates may obtain their call letters by following these steps:
 Visit the official website, ssc.gov.in , or the regional SSC website applicable to their region.
 Log in using the registration number or roll number and password.
 Navigate to the "Admit Card" or "Latest News" section on the homepage.
 Click on the link for the SSC GD Constable PET/PST Admit Card 2026.
 Select the region and enter the required credentials, such as the registration or roll number and date of birth or password.
 Click on the submit button, after which the admit card will be displayed on the screen.
 Verify all details, including name, roll number, test date, time and venue.
 Download the admit card in PDF format and take a clear printout.
 Important instructions for candidates 
 The admit card is a mandatory document for appearing in the physical tests, and candidates will not be permitted to participate without it. Aspirants should verify every detail printed on the call letter immediately after downloading it. In the event of any discrepancy, they should contact the concerned authority without delay. It is also advisable to carry a valid photo identification document along with the printed admit card on the day of the test. Candidates are further encouraged to rely only on the official websites, ssc.gov.in and rect.crpf.gov.in, for authentic updates and to avoid unverified sources.
